Eun Ho reveals the ugly truth of the past to the world. A new era of kings begins.

After her demotion, Su Jae leads a Legal Clinic Centre as an adjunct professor to rebuild her image.

A suspect dies, leaving a recorded call with Su Jae. Tae Guk exploits her absence for his own gain.
